image_prompt.text: A large stylized ancient sword embedded in a stone pedestal, blade pointing upward, big enough to be seen from anywhere on the island so players always know which way the centre is
A winding stone path across the grassy top, running from the central spawn platform out to the sword monument, giving the island one obvious grain of movement
Composed views looking out over the island's edge from beside the crystal cluster and from the foot of the sword monument, framed to read well from the spawn platform

A circular stone platform in the centre of the island where players appear, with bright blue-cyan magic runes carved into its face, placed so the path and the sword monument are the first things in view
A large rounded rock-and-dirt floating island base with grass over the top and stylized chunky rocks hanging beneath it, cartoon low-poly with bright saturated colour
A group of large pointed magic crystals glowing purple and blue, emerging from the ground to one side of the island
A small rounded wizard tower with a pointy cone roof and glowing windows, stylized and cartoonish
A simple wooden training dummy, post and crossbar, for sword practice
A few stylized cartoon trees with rounded puffy green canopies and thick brown trunks
Two glowing magic lamp posts flanking the spawn area, emitting warm orange light

layout_placement.text: Players arrive on the central rune-carved platform, oriented along the stone path so the sword monument is straight ahead

notes: No genre named: the prompt describes a place, a style and a theme rather than a game type — no combat, quests, scoring or objective anywhere in it. 'Think of a colorful RPG starter zone' is cited as a visual reference for the art style, not as declared gameplay, so it was not read as a self-declared RPG.

All five axes left at their defaults (exterior, single-surface, single zone, dressed, grounded surface), which routes P0. The floating island's hanging rocks are the underside of the one play surface, not a second tier, and nothing flies or swims.
Preset kept whole — landmark-focal, path-circulation and vignette-photo all survive the prompt — with spawn-area added on top for the described rune-carved arrival platform, which the preset lacks.

The prompt's remaining named parts (island base, crystal cluster, wizard tower, training dummy, trees, lantern posts) match no option row in the loaded file and are carried as free-text image entries so the build does not lose them.
'A few' trees is not a count, so it stays in the text; the two lantern posts carry count 2.
The exposed attributes the prompt asks for (crystalGlowColor, runeGlowColor, swordScale, treeCount) are model parameters rather than layout features — nothing in this handoff can carry them.

would have asked: Sounds like an explorable place — a stylized floating island you walk across, a sword monument landmark visible from anywhere, a winding stone path leading out to it, composed views over the edge, plus the central rune-carved spawn platform you described. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: do players go inside the wizard tower? Built it as an exterior with glowing windows, since enterable interiors need a separate indoor pass that isn't ready yet — say the word and I'll note it for when it is.

would have asked: should falling off the island's edge kill the player, or should the rim be fenced off by rocks and trees? Neither a drop hazard nor a map-limit edge was taken, since the prompt says nothing about it.
would have asked: anything else you want on the island?
